messages:
Ada: Quick heads-up — finalizing release notes and internal announce for v2.3.1. Plan: canary at 23:00 UTC tonight, full rollout + pin at 02:00 UTC. Who's taking announce copy and pin post?
Matt: I can take copy. Do we have the short bullet list for RN?
Ada: Draft below — please edit.
- Fixes: memory regression in seqcache (high-priority)
- Perf: ~12% gen latency improvement on 8k tokens (serving runtime)
- Feature: new intelligent batching toggle (opt-in)
- Ops: pin policy for Dedicated customers and fallback lanes
Sophia: Small wording tweak: change 'memory regression' -> 'memory regression fix' and add a rollback criteria line.
Matt: Updated draft pasted to the wiki: https://wiki.redwood.ai/releases/v2.3.1 — here's the RN short paragraph I plan to post to internal channels:
"We’re shipping v2.3.1 — includes a fix for a seqcache memory regression, a ~12% gen latency improvement on long sequences, an opt-in batching toggle, and Dedicated pinning options. Canary starts 23:00 UTC; full rollout ~02:00 UTC. Ops will monitor canary metrics; rollback if criteria met."
Sophia: Suggest adding explicit rollback criteria in the RN bullets: "Rollback if error rate > 2% for 5m OR P95 latency > 2s for 5m."
Matt: Added that line into the wiki under 'Rollback criteria'.
Elaine: I'll post the internal announcement to #all-hands at T-30m and create a follow-up thread for canary metrics. Ops will be watching the SLO dashboard. :eyes:
Samir: I will trigger the canary. DeployBot, can you confirm schedule and command?
DeployBot: Scheduled deploy created by Samir. ID: db-7892. Canary: 10% traffic for 30m. Full rollout target: 02:00 UTC. Command to run:
```
/deploy v2.3.1 --canary=10 --duration=30m --pin=rt-2.3.1
```
Oncall-bot: Tonight's oncall: primary @Elaine @Samir, backup @Kevin. Paging configured to #incidents and email.
Liza: One more ops ask — ensure model pin for Dedicated: "rt-model:2.3.1-quant" and fallback to "rt-model:2.2.8" if we need to abort. Also make sure dedicated customers get a pinned-notice in the internal RN.
Samir: Acknowledged. During canary, abort & roll back to 2.2.8 if error rate > 2% sustained for 5m or P95 > 2s for 5m. No objections?
Matt: No objections from docs/comms. I'll include clear language about pins and fallback in the announce.
Ada: Great. Final checklist: deploy scheduled (db-7892), announce copy in wiki and ready for posting, pin policy set, canary monitors & dashboards ready, rollback runbook linked (https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/rollback-v2.3.1). Elaine will post at 22:30 UTC. Thanks everyone. :tada:
Elaine: I'll post at 22:30 and DM Samir right before triggering. If anything unexpected, we'll abort and notify @all.
Samir: Kicking off at scheduled time, will update thread with deploybot events and canary metrics.
Ada: Thanks — I'll monitor the follow-up thread and stand by for the final green to proceed to full rollout.
